explore-freq.title: Sweep the frequency
explore-freq.prompt: Turn the frequency up until you reach the top of the audio range, about 20 kHz.
hints: Turn right. Each click is a small step on a log scale.
Stop when the band readout is near the edge of audio.
explore-freq.success: About 20 kHz: the top of human hearing. The period is now only 50 microseconds.

explore-harmonic.title: Twice the frequency
explore-harmonic.prompt: Switch on the second harmonic of this 2 kHz tone.
explore-harmonic.success: The dashed trace swings twice per cycle of the 2 kHz wave: 4 kHz, the second harmonic.
